topic: QR code error correction scribble test
hook: Your phone can scan a scribbled-on QR code.
title: Scribble on a QR Code. It Still Scans.
description:
QR codes carry spare repair data, so a phone can often read one that is partly covered or scribbled on. The strongest error-correction setting repairs up to about 30 percent damage, so use a code made with high error correction. Try it with a marker and your phone camera.

#Shorts #Tech #QRCode
comment_prompt: Did it still scan? Yes or no
